scope: Old raster from 65310d2 and corrected root raster, using the same instrumented verifier reporter. All 25 course/level cases and 75 fixed camera views compare exactly. Each also compares serial versus 6-worker parallel pixels, depth and full render receipt. No masks or tolerances.
